column1: # PikaOS-v2 package fleet: the single source of truth for what v2/pkg-build.sh
# builds (mirrors repo-tools/workflows' "one list, one build implementation").
# Format: one "<org>/<name>" per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# are ignored. The CI matrix and v2/ci/repo-index.sh both read this file.
# Scope: the KDE desktop plus the PikaOS application suite, rebuilt for
# x86-64-v2 from git.pika-os.com and compiled against normal Debian sid (the
# builder image is Debian, not the PikaOS v3 repositories).
# pika-meta: upstream debian/control has malformed Depends
# akondi-mime5: Build-Depends libkf5akonadi-dev (KF5), dropped from sid (KF6 only).
# Not buildable against plain Debian sid yet (TODO before enabling):
#   zig not packaged in sid:        pikainstall, pikafetch, falcond, falcon,
#     pika-paste (falcon also has a malformed patch in main.sh)
#   debhelper 13 dh_missing fails:  tuned (00-tuned.conf not installed anywhere)
#     pikd-pharser-rs (repo ships no main.sh), apx-gui (conflicting Source field)
